summary: Backend regression passed; public UI loaded with TopPass5 title and visible mobile brand. The automated mobile flow was inconclusive because the Playwright run stopped on a brittle CSS-pseudo-element/visibility assertion before registration, so full UI CRUD cannot be claimed.
action_items: Rerun mobile registration and vault CRUD with selectors that do not assert CSS pseudo-element text.
critical_code_review_comments: Vault effect now invokes load inside an effect callback, avoiding the prior Promise-as-cleanup crash.
seed_data_creation: Backend regression created and cleaned disposable TEST_ account/item data; UI disposable account creation was not confirmed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend auth/item lifecycle and unauthenticated protection passed. Mobile screenshot shows TOPPASS5 and title is TopPass5 — Secure Vault. Complete UI registration, login, create/reveal/copy/delete flow; Google link is present in the auth DOM.
rca of the issue: No application failure was reproduced in this iteration. First UI attempt used get_by_text for text generated by .brand::after, which is not in the DOM; second attempt stopped before flow completion on a brittle assertion.
